input.content:
Six weeks after launching Skycast 1.0 — three engineers, one 7-day forecast app on Android and iOS — here's what the retro taught us.

Three takeaways:

1. Beta testing paid off. 40 beta users found 11 bugs, and 9 of them were fixed before 1.0. Session crash rate fell from 4% to 0.5%, mostly by removing a background refresh that ran on low memory.

2. Cache beats network for perceived speed. Storing the last forecast on the device instead of waiting for the network cut app start time from 3.2 seconds to 1.1 seconds.

3. Cut what few people use. Hourly radar maps ate a third of our design time in the first month, and only 2 of 40 beta users opened them. We shipped 1.0 without them.

One habit worth keeping: a weekly 20-minute demo to the whole team caught two misunderstandings about forecast units early. Six-week result: 4.6 stars from 310 ratings. Loudest complaint: no widget yet.

What's a feature you cut and never missed?
